description: Optical pulse sensor that sticks onto the pulse LED of an energy meter and totalises its pulses over Modbus RTU (RS-485 and RS-232)
source: Circutor, "ReadWatt pulse sensor, Instruction manual", M018B01-10-22A
notes: Read with FC03 or FC04 and write with FC10; a request must cover the full size of each variable.
Both ports share one baud rate (9600, 19200 or 38400, 8N1). At start-up the LED flashes 1, 2 or 3 times to show 9600, 19200 or 38400.

The manual does not give the unit of the pulse and count registers, the word order of the 64-bit values or the format of the firmware version, so those are left as plain counts with the usual big-endian layout.
A broadcast write (address 0) to 0x0BBA changes the address and baud rate of a unit whose address is unknown. It needs the serial number and is not mapped here (manual 4.3.5).

registers.name: Pulse register
registers.description: Total pulses read from the meter LED

registers.name: Count register
registers.description: Counter totalised with the output pulse weight

registers.name: Count register (writable)
registers.description: Same kind of counter, which can be written to preset it

registers.name: Baud rate
registers.description: Default 0 (9600); shared by RS-232 and RS-485

registers.name: Output count weight
registers.description: Value added to the count register for each output pulse. Default 10

registers.name: Optical pulse to count ratio
registers.description: Ratio between the optical pulses and the count register. Default 1000

registers.name: Transformation ratio
registers.description: Voltage ratio times current ratio of a medium-voltage installation; 1 for direct measurement. Default 1

registers.name: Output pulse width
registers.description: Width of the pulse on the open-collector output. Default 100 ms; 2 to 250 ms

registers.name: Serial number
registers.description: Printed in decimal on the label

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: Three registers (6 bytes); the format is not documented
